headline: Rotary Pool reconstruction for up to $2,595,469, plus a $93,038.15 EV charger and other purchases.
summary: The largest request is $2,595,469 for Rotary Pool reconstruction. Three items tabled at the 11/4/26 meeting are also listed.
items: Spring Street Parking Lot EV charger installation, not to exceed $93,038.15
2027 Toyota bZ XLE AWD vehicle, not to exceed $32,747
2027 Harley-Davidson Police Road Glide, not to exceed $48,919.92
Amendment #1 for 4th of July fireworks, not to exceed $25,000
2027 portable toilet rentals, Change Order #7, not to exceed $69,268.00
Rotary Pool reconstruction, not to exceed $2,595,469.00
Amendment #2 for Nashua Transit System advertising revenue, not to exceed $100,000
Library Plaza design Amendment #6, not to exceed $6,500
Richard LaRose Way improvements, not to exceed $57,893
Procurement compliance for professional services with Charla Stevens and Robert Half
Sewer and drain flow monitoring system, not to exceed $25,000
R-26-078: First Amendment to High Street Garage Lease with Nashua Apartment Ventures, LLC
R-26-079: School Street Parking Garage Lease with Nashua Apartment Ventures, LLC
